app.title: Rumble Realms
battle.leaveText: The battle in progress will be lost.
detail.levelTestMode: Test mode: level can be chosen freely
deck.title: Your deck
deck.slotHint: Tap a place, then a card.
card.archer.name: Archer
card.archer.text: Shoots from a safe distance at ground and air.
card.knight.name: Knight
card.knight.text: Sturdy melee fighter with lots of health.
card.tnt.name: Walking TNT
card.tnt.text: Runs at the enemy and explodes, even if it dies first. Area damage!
card.skeleton.name: Skeletons
card.skeleton.text: A fast swarm of many small melee fighters.
card.healer.name: Healer
card.healer.text: Heals the most wounded ally nearby.
card.musketeer.name: Musketeer
card.musketeer.text: Shoots rarely, but very far and very hard.
card.bat.name: Bats
card.bat.text: They fly and can only be hit by ranged units.
card.assassin.name: Assassin
card.assassin.text: Jumps to the farthest enemy when the battle starts.
card.berserker.name: Berserker
card.berserker.text: Strikes faster the less health he has, and steals life.
card.shroomling.name: Shroomlings
card.shroomling.text: Leave a poisonous spore cloud when they die.
card.pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
card.pyromancer.text: Sets targets on fire and calls a meteor on the largest enemy group every 10 s.
card.necromancer.name: Necromancer
card.necromancer.text: Summons a weak skeleton every 4 seconds and also attacks on its own.
card.beetle.name: Bombardier Beetle
card.beetle.text: Shells the whole field with artillery and leaves acid puddles.
card.golem.name: Stone Golem
card.golem.text: Very slow and very tough, breaks into mini golems when it dies.
card.frost_shaman.name: Frost Shaman
card.frost_shaman.text: Freezes targets with hits and slows enemies nearby.
card.whelp.name: Dragon Whelp
card.whelp.text: Breathes fire in a cone and grows over time.
detail.upgradesTestMode: Test mode: upgrades can be switched freely
upgrade.archer.fire_arrows.name: Fire Arrows
upgrade.archer.fire_arrows.text: Hits set the target on fire for 3 s (8 damage/s).
upgrade.archer.volley.name: Volley
upgrade.archer.volley.text: Every 4th shot hits up to 3 targets.
upgrade.archer.eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
upgrade.knight.shield.name: Shield
upgrade.knight.charge.name: Charge
upgrade.knight.charge.text: The first hit after moving deals double damage and stuns for 0.5 s.
upgrade.knight.taunt.name: Taunt
upgrade.knight.taunt.text: Enemies within 2 fields must attack him if they can.
upgrade.tnt.daughter_tnt.name: Daughter TNT
upgrade.tnt.daughter_tnt.text: After the blast 1 mini TNT appears (50 % HP, 50 % damage) with no daughter of its own.
upgrade.tnt.short_fuse.name: Short Fuse
upgrade.tnt.armored_crate.name: Armored Crate
upgrade.skeleton.undead.name: Undead
upgrade.skeleton.undead.text: 2 s after death it rises once as a zombie with 40 % HP.
upgrade.skeleton.bone_hail.name: Bone Hail
upgrade.skeleton.bone_hail.text: On death 15 damage to all adjacent enemies.
upgrade.skeleton.rattle_gang.name: Rattle Gang
upgrade.healer.heal_circle.name: Healing Circle
upgrade.healer.heal_circle.text: Heals all allies within 2 fields for 60 % of the healing each.
upgrade.healer.revive.name: Revival
upgrade.healer.revive.text: Once per round the first ally that dies in range returns with 50 % HP.
upgrade.healer.blessing.name: Blessing
upgrade.healer.blessing.text: Healed allies deal +20 % damage for 3 s.
upgrade.musketeer.pierce.name: Pierce
upgrade.musketeer.pierce.text: The bullet also hits the enemy right behind with 50 %.
upgrade.musketeer.headshot.name: Headshot
upgrade.musketeer.headshot.text: The first shot of every round deals triple damage.
upgrade.musketeer.bayonet.name: Bayonet
upgrade.musketeer.bayonet.text: With an adjacent enemy: melee (45 damage, 1.0 s) instead of shooting.
upgrade.bat.bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
upgrade.bat.swarm.name: Swarm
upgrade.bat.ultrasound.name: Ultrasound
upgrade.bat.ultrasound.text: Hits slow the target's attack speed by 25 % for 2 s.
upgrade.assassin.poison.name: Poison
upgrade.assassin.poison.text: Hits poison: 12 damage/s for 4 s, renewed.
upgrade.assassin.shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
upgrade.assassin.shadow_step.text: If his target dies he jumps to the farthest enemy (cooldown 6 s).
upgrade.assassin.smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
upgrade.assassin.smoke_bomb.text: Not targetable for 2 s after every jump.
upgrade.berserker.unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
upgrade.berserker.unstoppable.text: Dropping below 20 % HP makes him invulnerable for 2 s (once per round).
upgrade.berserker.whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
upgrade.berserker.whirlwind.text: Every 3rd attack hits all adjacent enemies.
upgrade.berserker.blood_frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
upgrade.berserker.blood_frenzy.text: Every kill heals 15 % of max HP.
upgrade.shroomling.giant_mushroom.name: Giant Mushroom
upgrade.shroomling.giant_mushroom.text: One of the four grows big (3x HP and 3x damage).
upgrade.shroomling.contagious.name: Contagious
upgrade.shroomling.contagious.text: Poisoned enemies release a spore cloud when they die.
upgrade.shroomling.mycelium.name: Mycelium
upgrade.shroomling.mycelium.text: Neighbouring shroomlings heal each other by 5 HP/s.
upgrade.pyromancer.inferno.name: Inferno
upgrade.pyromancer.meteor.name: Meteor
upgrade.pyromancer.meteor.text: Every 10 s a meteor hits the largest group of enemies (200 damage, radius 1.5).
upgrade.pyromancer.heat_shield.name: Heat Shield
upgrade.pyromancer.heat_shield.text: The first 2 hits against her are ignored.
upgrade.necromancer.bone_army.name: Bone Army
upgrade.necromancer.bone_army.text: A skeleton every 3 s, at most 6.
upgrade.necromancer.soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
upgrade.necromancer.soul_harvest.text: When an enemy dies within 3 fields, +1 skeleton appears at once.
upgrade.necromancer.lich_form.name: Lich Form
upgrade.necromancer.lich_form.text: On death he returns once as a flying ghost with 50 % HP.
upgrade.beetle.acid_pool.name: Acid Pool
upgrade.beetle.acid_pool.text: The impact leaves acid for 3 s (25 damage/s).
upgrade.beetle.double_load.name: Double Load
upgrade.beetle.double_load.text: 2 projectiles at 2 different targets, 60 % damage each.
upgrade.beetle.chitin_armor.name: Chitin Armor
upgrade.beetle.chitin_armor.text: +60 % HP; melee attackers take 15 recoil damage.
upgrade.golem.stone_skin.name: Stone Skin
upgrade.golem.earthquake.name: Quake
upgrade.golem.earthquake.text: Every 6 s 60 area damage (radius 1.5) and 30 % slow for 2 s.
upgrade.golem.rubble.name: Rubble
upgrade.golem.rubble.text: On death 3 mini golems with 20 % of the stats appear.
upgrade.frost_shaman.ice_block.name: Ice Block
upgrade.frost_shaman.ice_block.text: Every 4th hit freezes the target for 1 s.
upgrade.frost_shaman.frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
upgrade.frost_shaman.frost_nova.text: At the start of battle and every 12 s enemies within 2 fields freeze for 1.5 s.
upgrade.frost_shaman.ice_armor.name: Ice Armor
upgrade.whelp.fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
upgrade.whelp.fire_breath.text: Cone instead of circle area damage, +1 range.
upgrade.whelp.ember_scales.name: Ember Scales
upgrade.whelp.growth.name: Growth
upgrade.whelp.growth.text: Every 10 s +15 % damage and size (at most 3 times).
